source.title: India national input-output tables at current prices, 2000 and 2007–2024
source.publicationPrecision: month, as listed by ADB for this resource
source.vintage: August 2025 portal vintage; OOXML modified November 2025
source.revisionStatus: Harmonized ADB workbook pinned by SHA-256; national source revision not separately asserted
source.license: CC BY 3.0 IGO, as listed for the India National Input-Output Tables series in the ADB Data Library
source.redistribution: Attributed processed observations only. Original workbook remains available from ADB and is not redistributed here.
source.extraction: Read only scoped XLSX cells from sheets named 2023 and 2024. No spreadsheet formulas executed.
source.transformation: Keep domestic industry rows separately from imported inputs; remove all-zero domestic c35 after validation.
source.missingValues: Any blank or nonnumeric required cell fails extraction. Zero domestic output in c35 is explicitly excluded.
source.limitations: ADB harmonized statistical estimates, not MoSPI raw supply-use tables; national, current USD. Nonzero imported c35 is retained in column sums.
source.verificationStatus: Publisher download and workbook digest verified; accounting checked by the extract pipeline.
